requirements.check: manual: genlock cause set with root cause

requirements.text: Pane headers show a real title for sessions that have task chips, in the running app
requirements.check: eye: background screenshot of the running app

name: Screenshot 2026-11-14 at 6.55.24 AM.png
why: TJ's report: three pane headers show '...' for title

name: before-top.png
why: repro: 8-pane grid at 1344pt, installed app: every pane header '…'

name: after-top.png
why: fix: same drive, built app: resting panes show full names

evidence: cause on record: opacity-0 controls still reserved ~220pt in split headers (SessionsView header, .opacity(showsControls) on an inline HStack)
driven 8-pane grid, window 1344x760, background snapshot: installed app headers 'B • …', 'A • …', 'K • …', 'O • …'; rebuilt app 'kitchenledger', 'orchard' in full, header height unchanged
a layout truncation has no unit seam; the repeatable check is the driven background screenshot recorded as the preventive

fields.symptom: grid pane headers show '…' instead of the session name
fields.root_cause: in a split, the header's ~6 control buttons are faded with opacity 0 but still laid out in the row, so a ~336pt pane leaves ~30pt for the name, which truncates to an ellipsis
whys: hidden controls were kept in the layout on purpose so names would not shift on hover
the room left at four panes across (the narrow-pane boundary) was never checked
fields.corrective: in a split the controls float in a trailing overlay over a faded backdrop; the row keeps their height via a zero-width hidden copy, so names take the full width and never shift
fields.preventive: drive an 8-pane grid at 1344pt and screenshot the headers in the background before changing pane header layout
fields.gate: manual: before landing header layout changes

answers.observed: before-top.png: 4 headers read '…'; after-top.png: 'kitchenledger','orchard' full, same drive script and store
answers.cause: measured: same input, only the layout change differs; '…' is SwiftUI tail truncation of tabLabel, which the report shows non-empty for all 8
answers.absence: tabLabels in the driver report are populated in both runs, so the title was never missing, only squeezed
answers.assumption: TJ's '…' panes were unhovered non-key grid panes; the key/hovered pane still has its name partly under the buttons by design
answers.falsify: a resting grid pane in the rebuilt app still showing '…' at 1344pt with 8 panes would falsify it; it did not
